schemeScope: Combined Paper 1 and Paper 2 scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 listening tariffs; 4–6 listening transcript (never shown to students); 7–11 listening answers; 12–17 composition marking, annotation symbols, Stíl/Ábhar/Gaeilge bands and S1–S4 grades; 48 modified marking (SMM). PDF 18–47 are Paper 2; 49–52 blank.
reviewMethod: Visual inspection of every paper page (answer-booklet pages 8–19 are ruled writing space) and every applicable scheme page; cross-checked extracted text.

audio.note: One SEC recording serves the Higher and Ordinary 2025 listening test; all 2025 listening cards already play it (commit ef1a7e550).

nonPoolDecisions: Listening: “Scríobh síos dhá …/Luaigh dhá …” asks for two points at 2 + 2; the scheme lists more accepted points than required. These are answer keys for one task, not task routes.

Card unit for listening: the eight retained legacy segment cards (Fógra, Mír, Píosa) keep their IDs and stay the card unit, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion at its published 2 or 2 + 2 tariff (24 questions, 60 marks). Separate question cards are not added: they would repeat the same prompts inside that exercise.

Composition: A–C is a closed choose-one; the nine printed titles are the routes and were already carded (IDs retained). AISTE nó ALT (form) and the debate stance (ar son nó ina aghaidh) stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: Cuid I listening 60 (Cuid A 18 = Fógra 1 10 + Fógra 2 8; Cuid B 28 = Comhrá 1 14 + Comhrá 2 14; Cuid C 14 = Píosa 1 6 + Píosa 2 8), every question 2 marks or 2 + 2; Cuid II composition 100 (choose one of A, B, C).
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 3 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” (scheme PDF 3 and 11) is one section-level deduction; each card states it without applying it.
Comhrá 2 An Chéad Mhír Q3: the scheme notes the paper omitted the séimhiú on ‘deirfiúr’ (“dá deirfiúr”); kept as printed.
Composition S4 (“Easnamhach”) applies only to A(a), A(d), A(e) and C(b) in 2025 (scheme PDF 17).

Legacy corrections (IDs, totals and topics unchanged): the Píosa a Dó segment card had composition text leaked into its answer key; each segment card had one undivided criterion; the nine composition cards carried paraphrased English marking notes and no S1–S4 grades. All now carry the lifted 2025 scheme text and per-question tariffs.
